title: The Tarantula Nebula in Infrared
explanation: The Tarantula Nebula, also known as 30 Doradus, is the largest and most active star-forming region in the Local Group of galaxies. Located in the Large Magellanic Cloud about 160,000 light-years away, it spans over 1,000 light-years. This infrared view reveals intricate filaments of gas and dust sculpted by the radiation and stellar winds of massive young stars at its core.
